goal: Prove from the implemented single-literal RUP semantics a polynomial per-ladder progress bound, then independently replay the frozen AN witness and falsify the bound if any accepted RUP or interleaved R33 step violates its stated premises.

frozen_structural_lemma_candidate.rup_local_descent: Every accepted first_rup_strengthening removes exactly one literal from one existing source clause before canonicalization; canonical_formula only deduplicates literals/clauses, so L(F_after_RUP) <= L(F_before_RUP)-1, C_after<=C_before, V_after<=V_before.
frozen_structural_lemma_candidate.candidate_count_per_search: At most L current one-literal deletion candidates are inspected.
frozen_structural_lemma_candidate.up_full_scan_bound_per_candidate: At most V+1 full formula scans because every changed scan assigns at least one previously unassigned variable and one final scan detects fixpoint/conflict.
frozen_structural_lemma_candidate.successful_rup_count_bound_under_nonincr: If all operators interleaved between accepted RUP steps do not increase L, then successful_RUP_count <= L_start.
frozen_structural_lemma_candidate.complexity_scope: Polynomial bound for one RUP ladder satisfying the nonincreasing-interleaving premise; NOT a universal end-to-end SAT runtime theorem.

non_blocking_diagnostic: AI_slack need not increase on every individual RUP step; a local slack decrease does not falsify the literal-potential lemma.
next_gate_policy: Do not launch R50G25AP in this gate. Seal AO first in Fundamentum journal/receipt and janus-meta-registry dual ledger.
